story.title: Our story
story.body: We exist so that the family businesses forming the backbone of Turkish industry can use AI not as a trend, but as a tool that creates measurable business value. We build digital advisors and enterprise AI systems that connect to your data, are trained for your industry, and work alongside your team — never as a replacement for it.
